instructions: Use tickadoo to discover, compare, and check public availability information for theatre, attractions, tours, and experiences worldwide.

tools.description: Return ranked, currently on-sale catalogue candidates for a city, optional title query, category, tags, rating, review-count, and price filters. Each result includes an opaque product_id for provider-neutral follow-up calls and a public slug for comparison. Confirm a selected date with get_availability before claiming it is available.

indoor_outdoor.description: Optional setting filter. 'indoor' and 'outdoor' resolve through catalogue tags; 'either' applies no setting filter.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-50). Default 10.

max_price.description: Maximum price per person in the listed currency. A positive value applies a cap; 0 (or unset) means no price cap (unbounded).

min_rating.description: Minimum aggregate rating on a 0-5 scale.

min_review_count.description: Minimum number of customer reviews. Use to filter out new or sparsely-reviewed products.

popular_only.description: DEPRECATED: use restrict_to_top_rated. Alias for the hard top-rated result filter (rating >= 4.5 AND review_count >= 100). The name implies a sort hint but it is a hard WHERE clause. Existing callers continue to work unchanged.

query.description: Free-text query matched against experience name and venue (not description). Split into words that must all match, so it suits a title or keyword; a query that matches no name returns city top-picks flagged match_type "fallback_city_ranked".

restrict_to_top_rated.description: HARD RESULT FILTER. When true, restricts results to products with rating >= 4.5 AND review_count >= 100. This is a WHERE clause, not a sort hint. Anything failing the floor is dropped from the result set entirely. Use only when the caller genuinely wants to exclude lower-rated or lesser-reviewed products. For ranking-by-popularity without exclusion, do not set this; results are already ordered by rating and review count.

tags.description: Filter by experience tags. Multiple tags are AND-combined (every tag must match) so adding more tags narrows the result set. Use lowercase singular forms; matching is substring-based against the tag array. The canonical tag taxonomy in the catalogue, ordered by frequency, is: 'tour', 'attraction', 'historical', 'outdoor', 'museum', 'family', 'landmark', 'adventure', 'show', 'indoor', 'food & drink', 'transport', 'theatre', 'concert', 'theme park', 'cruise', 'nightlife', 'comedy', 'musical', 'city pass', 'sport', 'dance', 'aquarium', 'zoo', 'gallery', 'opera', 'wellness', 'water park', 'workshop', 'religious', 'festival'. Examples: ['museum'] for museums; ['family','indoor'] for indoor family attractions; ['outdoor','adventure'] for outdoor adventure activities. Other free-form values may match by substring but are not guaranteed.

tools.name: search_experiences

tools.description: Use this when the user mentions a place, neighbourhood, landmark, or area but does not give exact coordinates. Examples: 'near the Louvre', 'in Trastevere', 'around Times Square', "walking distance from St Paul's Cathedral". Returns experiences matched first by exact venue/neighbourhood, then by city centre fallback. Do not use for general city-wide search; use search_experiences for that.

city.description: City slug or name to disambiguate. Recommended for any place_hint that could exist in multiple cities.

date_from.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD accepted for compatibility. This search does not apply a date window; use get_availability to check live dates for a selected product.

date_to.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD accepted for compatibility. This search does not apply a date window; use get_availability to check live dates for a selected product.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-50). Default 10.

neighbourhood.description: Optional: a known neighbourhood within the city to narrow results.

place_hint.description: Free-text place reference: a landmark, neighbourhood, monument, station, or street name. E.g. 'Louvre Museum', 'Trastevere', 'Soho', 'Times Square'. Required.

radius_hint.description: Optional: how broadly to interpret the place_hint. 'walking' is ~1km, 'short_drive' is ~5km, 'city_wide' falls back to the whole city. Default 'walking'.

tags.description: Filter by experience tags. Multiple tags are AND-combined (every tag must match) so adding more tags narrows the result set. Use lowercase singular forms; matching is substring-based against the tag array. The canonical tag taxonomy in the catalogue, ordered by frequency, is: 'tour', 'attraction', 'historical', 'outdoor', 'museum', 'family', 'landmark', 'adventure', 'show', 'indoor', 'food & drink', 'transport', 'theatre', 'concert', 'theme park', 'cruise', 'nightlife', 'comedy', 'musical', 'city pass', 'sport', 'dance', 'aquarium', 'zoo', 'gallery', 'opera', 'wellness', 'water park', 'workshop', 'religious', 'festival'. Examples: ['museum'] for museums; ['family','indoor'] for indoor family attractions; ['outdoor','adventure'] for outdoor adventure activities. Other free-form values may match by substring but are not guaranteed.

tools.name: search_local_experiences

tools.description: Return evening-appropriate experience candidates for a city. A start_time appears only when the live calendar confirms one; use get_availability before claiming a specific time is available.

category.description: Optional category slug to narrow results.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

tools.name: whats_on_tonight

tools.description: Return ranked, currently-on-sale experience candidates for the requested city and time window. Confirm a selected candidate with get_availability before claiming a specific time is available.

hours.description: How many hours ahead to look (1-12). Default 3.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

tools.name: get_last_minute

tools.description: Use this when the user wants ideas for the coming week in a city. Returns a ranked list of currently on-sale experiences (search rows) with out-of-season products dropped, not a day-by-day calendar. Assemble any weekly structure yourself and verify specific dates with get_availability.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

tools.name: get_whats_on_this_week

tools.description: Return ranked experience candidates from a natural-language preference and optional city, price, result-count, and language inputs.

city.description: Optional city slug. If omitted, the city is parsed from the query.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

limit.description: Number of recommendations to return (1-20). Default 5.

query.description: Natural-language preference, e.g., "romantic evening in Paris under 100 euros" or "rainy day in Edinburgh with kids 8 and 12".

tools.name: recommend_experiences

tools.description: Return a ranked overview of currently on-sale catalogue candidates for a city, including public prices and ratings. Confirm a selected date with get_availability before claiming it is available.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

tools.name: get_city_highlights

tools.description: Return ranked experience candidates for a city. This tool does not generate prose travel advice or apply a topic filter.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

tools.name: search_experiences_by_topic

tools.description: Compare 2-5 selected experiences from one or more cities. Pass every value as city_slug/product_slug using the city and slug returned by an earlier public-agent result; each product_slug component must be distinct.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

slugs.description: City-scoped public paths in city_slug/product_slug form from earlier results. Each product_slug component must be distinct.

tools.name: compare_experiences

tools.description: Use this when the user wants lower-profile options rather than headline bestsellers. Excludes Bestseller, hop-on-hop-off, and CityPass tagged products and prefers highly rated rows with fewer reviews; falls back to the standard ranked list when a city has too few qualifying rows (results may then overlap with headline search).

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

tools.name: get_hidden_gems

tools.description: Return ranked, in-season family-oriented experience candidates for a city. Arrange the day and verify selected dates separately.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

tools.name: get_family_day

tools.description: Return ranked, in-season date-night experience candidates for a city. Arrange the evening and verify selected dates separately.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

tools.name: get_date_night

tools.description: Return flat, ranked experience candidates for the requested city and number of days. The calling agent must arrange sequencing and verify dates.

audience.description: Optional audience signal. The 'family' value resolves through the family catalogue tag; other values are best-effort and may be sparsely populated.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

tools.name: get_itinerary_candidates

tools.description: Use this when the user wants to browse supported cities before searching. Returns city names, slugs, country codes, and product counts.

country.description: Optional country code or country name filter.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of cities to return (1-50). Defaults to 50 when omitted.

tools.name: list_cities

tools.description: Return provider-neutral public product, location, price, rating, and image fields for one selected experience. Requires the opaque product_id from an earlier public-agent result.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

product_id.description: Opaque product_id returned by this public-agent endpoint. Raw inventory IDs are rejected.

tools.name: get_experience_details

tools.description: Use this when the user asks about a specific show: how long it is, age guidance, venue and address, typical curtain times and dark days, who it is good for, and this week's performances. One rich guide record fusing live catalogue data with theatre expertise. Accepts slug or product_id.

city_slug.description: City slug, required when slug is used (slugs are only unique per city).

product_id.description: Opaque product_id returned by this public-agent endpoint. Raw inventory IDs are rejected.

slug.description: Product slug from a previous search result. Requires city_slug.

tools.name: get_show_guide

tools.description: Use this when the user asks what theatre is on this weekend or next. Server-side date math resolves the Friday/Saturday/Sunday dates; returns theatre shows in the city with scheduled performances on those days, grouped by day. Schedule data, not live seat inventory.

city.description: City name, resolved to a slug.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

limit.description: Max shows to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_theatre_weekend

tools.description: Return a concise grounded answer plus provider-neutral theatre candidates for a free-text theatre question.

city.description: City name, resolved to a slug.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

tools.name: ask_theatre_concierge

tools.description: Use this when the user has an occasion: family outing, date night, group celebration, solo culture trip, business entertainment. Returns ranked theatre shows with fit scores and reasons, honouring party ages and an optional date.

city.description: City name, resolved to a slug.

date.description: ISO date or natural language like this Saturday.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

tools.name: find_theatre_for_occasion

tools.description: Return provider-neutral related experience candidates for one opaque product_id, without supplier provenance or precise coordinates.

context.description: Relationship type: pair, after, nearby, or similar.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

max_results.description: Number of related products to return. Default 6, max 10.

product_id.description: Opaque product_id returned by this public-agent endpoint. Raw inventory IDs are rejected.

tools.name: get_related_experiences

tools.description: Return live public dates, times, prices, and remaining-space hints for one selected experience. Accepts an opaque product_id or public slug plus city_slug. Slot price.amount is in minor currency units (pence/cents): amount 13125 with currency_code GBP means GBP 131.25.

as_of.description: Previous ISO timestamp from an earlier availability response; returns a delta only when data changed.

city_slug.description: City slug required when slug is used.

date_from.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD, or a natural-language phrase the server resolves: today, tomorrow, this Saturday, next Friday, this weekend, next weekend. Defaults to today.

date_to.description: End date as YYYY-MM-DD or a natural-language phrase (same as date_from). Defaults to 14 days after date_from and is capped to a 365-day window.

fresh.description: When true, bypasses the 60-second cache and performs a live supplier check, subject to rate limits.

preferred_time.description: Optional broad time preference such as morning, afternoon, or evening.

product_id.description: Opaque product_id returned by this public-agent endpoint. Raw inventory IDs are rejected.

slug.description: Product slug. Use with city_slug when product_id is unavailable.

tools.name: get_availability

tools.description: Check one selected experience on exactly one date. Pass slug as city_slug/product_slug using the city and slug returned by an earlier public-agent result.

date.description: Date to check as YYYY-MM-DD, or a natural-language phrase the server resolves: today, tomorrow, this Saturday, next Friday, this weekend, next weekend.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

party_size.description: Number of guests or tickets to price. Default 2.

slug.description: City-scoped public path in city_slug/product_slug form from an earlier result.

tools.name: check_availability

tools.description: Use this when the user describes the feeling or vibe they want rather than a category, such as romantic, relaxing, adventurous, family fun, foodie, luxury, or rainy day. Maps the mood to preset search filters and returns matching experiences.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. "london", "new-york", or "paris".

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of experiences to return (1-50). Defaults to the mood preset size when omitted.

mood.description: Mood preset. Valid values: adventurous, romantic, relaxing, family_fun, cultural, thrill_seeking, foodie, budget_friendly, luxury, rainy_day.

tools.name: search_by_mood
